# Partition functions

Claims from wiphy.org; sits beside the existing statistical-mechanics modules.

claims.name: partitionFunction_fermion_polynomial
claims.statement: Partition function is a polynomial of degree $N$ in fugacity $x$ characterizing fermion excitations despite superficial singularities

sources.title: Line defects and 5d instanton partition functions

claims.name: grandCanonical_counts_bpsStates
claims.statement: Entropy from saddle-point of partition function: $e^{S(q_a,j_i)} = c(q_a,j_i)= \int \frac{d\Delta_a}{2\pi}\,\frac{d\omega_i}{2\pi}\,\mathcal{Z}(\Delta_a,\omega_i)\,e^{-i\bigl(\Delta_a q_a+\omega_i j_i\bigr)}$

sources.title: Lectures on AdS Black Holes, Holography and Localization
